concerns.text: T004 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe), but its Verification clause requires "applying all three methods to one filtered dataset" — an artifact produced only by T003. The stated execution order (T001 ∥ T002 → T003 → T004) already sequences T004 after T003, so the [P] tag contradicts both its own verification and the execution order. Either drop the [P] tag or make the verification self-contained (e.g., apply to synthetic positive/non-positive arrays in the unit tests only).
